meta.name: repo-intake-and-plan
meta.description: Rigor Intake helper for README-first deep learning repo reproduction. Use when the task is specifically to scan a repository, read the README and common project files, extract documented commands, classify inference, evaluation, and training candidates, and return the smallest trustworthy reproduction plan to the main orchestrator. Do not use for environment setup, asset download, command execution, final reporting, paper lookup, or end-to-end orchestration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫一遍仓库的说明与配置文件,列出一份最靠谱的最小复现步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果拿到一个开源深度学习仓库,想先弄清怎么跑起来再动手
copy.tagline_en: Scan a repo's docs and files, then list the shortest reproduction steps.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have an open-source deep learning repo and want to know how to run it.

howto.what: 扫描目标仓库，读 README 和常见项目文件，提取其中写明的命令，把推理、评估、训练等候选分类，最后给出一份最小可信的复现计划交回主流程。
howto.when: 在 README 优先的复现工作开始时触发，也用于需要仓库结构与文档命令快速地图、或用户只想先看仓库不想执行任何东西时。

say.text: 扫一下这个仓库，把 README 里写明的命令列出来
say.note: 只扫描和整理，不执行命令

say.text: 读完 README 后，把推理、评估、训练的候选分个类
say.note: 保守归类，附歧义与风险清单

say.text: 先别跑任何东西，给我一份最小的可信复现计划
say.note: 产出计划供主流程使用

howto.what_en: Scans a target repository, reads the README and common project files, extracts documented commands, classifies inference, evaluation and training candidates, and returns the smallest trustworthy reproduction plan to the orchestrator.
howto.when_en: Use at the start of README-first reproduction work, or when a fast map of repo structure and documented commands is needed and nothing should be run yet.

say_en.text: Scan this repo and list the commands documented in the README
say_en.note: Scan and plan only; it runs nothing

say_en.text: After the README, classify inference, evaluation and training candidates
say_en.note: Conservative labels plus an ambiguity and risk list

say_en.text: Don't run anything yet; give me the smallest trustworthy reproduction plan
say_en.note: Returns a plan to the main orchestrator
